report.title: Something’s not right
report.lead: Tell us what you saw. We’ll check it and fix it.

placeholder.CONTENT: For example: that isn’t the right answer, or there’s a typo.
placeholder.BUG: For example: I tap the button and nothing happens.
placeholder.MARKET: For example: the price doesn’t match the real one.

report.context: We send the screen you’re on (and the lesson, question or asset) along with your report so we can find it faster.

reports.title: Bug reports
reports.what: What users send with “Something’s not right”: wrong content, app bugs or market data.
reports.question: Question

gift.title: Plan and gifts
gift.stripeNote: Pays with Stripe: a gift doesn’t change the plan they pay for. It pushes back their next charge by the days you give.
gift.teamNote: Team member: already uses the app with everything unlocked.
gift.confirm: Gift {what} to {email}? They’ll get a notification.
gift.confirmStripe: {email} pays with Stripe: the gift will push back their next charge by {n} days ({what} free). Continue?
gift.reason: Reason (optional, only the team sees it)
gift.confirmRevoke: Remove the running gift from {email}? They go back to Free right now.

user.viewOnly: You’re viewing the app as another user: controls are off. Leave “view as” to use them.
user.title: Controls
user.confirmStreak: Set {email}’s streak to {n} days? It will count as if they used the app yesterday.
user.confirmWelcome: Send the welcome notification to {email} again?
user.confirmUnblock: Unblock {email}? They’ll be able to sign in again.
user.confirmBlock: Block {email}? Their sessions will be closed and they won’t be able to sign in.
user.blockNote: This doesn’t cancel their Stripe subscription: if they pay, handle it in Stripe too.
